title: ShadeLabel
description: Label of the shade grid for the 3D view (Contract 5): shade/{id}_skyline.bin and shade/{id}_normal.bin. Cells are laid out like the terrain patch (rows north to south, columns west to east). _skyline.bin holds n * n * n_az little-endian Int16 values, the azimuths of one cell together, starting at north and going clockwise; degrees = stored value * skyline_scale. _normal.bin holds n * n * 3 little-endian Float32 values: the unit surface normal of each cell as (east, north, up). All azimuths, elevations and normals are in the east/north/up frame of the patch centre, not of the individual cell.

version.description: Format version of this file. Increased on any format change.

center_lat.description: Latitude of the patch centre (the site), degrees.

center_lon.description: Longitude of the patch centre (the site), degrees, east positive.

size_m.description: Side length of the grid, metres: (n - 1) * spacing_m.

az_step_deg.description: Spacing between azimuths, degrees. 360 / az_step_deg = n_az.

n_az.description: Number of azimuths stored per cell.

skyline_scale.description: Multiply a stored Int16 by this to get degrees.

mast_m.description: Eye height above the ground used for every cell, metres.

dem.description: Names of the elevation map(s) used. Show this with every result.

resolution_m.description: Pixel size of the finest elevation map used near the point, metres. Show this with every result.
